title: Mai Mercado / Christiania 2016 — Toxic Source and Claim Audit
purpose: Audit the case for provable contradictions, materially misleading formulations, source contamination, timeline problems and allegations that remain unverified. This file does not diagnose any person or treat disputed claims as established facts.
identity_rule: The 2016 legal actor is the Son. Do not expose the Son's real name or family names.
core_judgment: The surviving public record supports a more complicated story than a simple random-threat narrative. Mercado's own inflammatory Christiania post initiated the controversy; the Son contemporaneously denied violent intent and said he sought dialogue; the referral chain has conflicting descriptions; the thread had multiple speakers; and later reporting progressively compresses disputed language into settled labels. These facts justify suspicion about attribution and framing. They do not yet prove that Mercado knowingly fabricated a false flag or knowingly caused another user's words to be attributed to the Son.

directly_supported_findings.finding: Mercado's initiating post used deliberately forceful rhetoric celebrating police destruction of Christiania hash stalls.
The Son denied guilt at the remand hearing and appealed detention.

He told the court he wanted dialogue so Mercado would understand why people with ADHD, sclerosis and cancer used cannabis medically, and that he did not intend to seek her out and carry out death threats.
directly_supported_findings.significance: This independently anchors the later 'not a threat / mirror / reciprocal rhetoric' account as more than a purely retrospective invention.

directly_supported_findings.finding: The remand article says Folketingets sikkerhedsafdeling reported the threats after contact from Mercado.
A Ritzau account says another Facebook user reported the case and Mercado said she herself did not make the police report.
Those referral descriptions are not equivalent and need reconciliation.
The Facebook event involved multiple speakers and later multiple defendants.
The earliest local courtroom report presents ellipsis-separated fragments instead of a preserved reply tree or transcript.
Later wire-service articles convert fragments and attributed reporting into cleaner declarative sentences and threat labels.

high_risk_source_transformations.risk: Comments by different Facebook users may be discussed generically as 'the threats'.
A reply directed to another commenter may later be read as if addressed directly to Mercado.
An ambiguous warning/prediction or third-party formulation becomes summarized later as 'he threatened her'.
JydskeVestkysten/Ritzau material is republished and appears like multiple independent corroborations.
Mercado's inflammatory initiating rhetoric becomes background while later coverage foregrounds only her victim status.

sweden_claim_audit.courtroom_report: At the June 21, 2016 remand hearing, the prosecutor reportedly said Mercado and her family became worried and unsafe and therefore hurried to Sweden, where they borrowed a summer house.
sweden_claim_audit.current_public_verification: The accessible article confirms that this account was presented in court, but does not independently establish departure date, booking date, trip purpose, duration or whether it was pre-planned vacation.
sweden_claim_audit.project_counterclaim: The user/Son account says the Sweden trip was an ordinary vacation occurring later, after the Son had already been detained for weeks, making the 'fled because of immediate fear' narrative false or misleading.
sweden_claim_audit.current_grade: IMPORTANT TIMELINE DISPUTE; NOT YET PROVEN FALSE
decisive_evidence: travel or booking records if voluntarily available

referral_chain_audit.model_c: Both happened as separate referrals concerning the same or different comments/defendants.
referral_chain_audit.model_d: Later journalism conflated separate reports into one story.
referral_chain_audit.current_best_reading: Mercado was plausibly upstream of at least one formal institutional referral. That does not prove she personally filed the complaint or controlled police action.
referral_chain_audit.false_flag_relevance: If primary records show the supposed independent report did not exist, or that Mercado's contact initiated the same referral she later distanced herself from, the false-flag/manipulation hypothesis would materially strengthen.

son_defense_audit.mirror_reciprocity: Later autobiographical formulation, partly corroborated by contemporary denial of violent intent and stated desire for dialogue.
son_defense_audit.death_wish: The phrase can function as rhetorical 'are you out of your mind?' or as intimidation depending on context; missing parent/addressee data prevents resolution.
son_defense_audit.witness_intimidation: The court treated the later consequences statement as witness intimidation. The Son's account interprets it as cause-and-effect/karma rather than a promise of personal retaliation.
son_defense_audit.archive_rule: Preserve both the legal finding and claimed intended meaning.

claims_that_should_not_be_stated_as_fact: Mercado personally called or controlled a secret political-police unit.
Police knowingly used another speaker's comments against the Son.
Mercado deleted the thread specifically to destroy exculpatory evidence.
The Sweden trip is already proven to have been a pre-planned vacation.
Mercado's later cancer proves divine or karmic punishment.
Mercado has a psychiatric pattern of pathological lying.
claims_that_are_reasonable_to_investigat: Whether Mercado's public 'I did not report it' statement was technically true but materially incomplete because she initiated a parliamentary-security referral.
Whether the unnamed Facebook user's report concerned the Son, another commenter, or the Jo Cox remark specifically.
Whether later articles merged statements by multiple speakers.
Whether Mercado's later recollections generalized across different defendants and statements.
Whether deletion of the Facebook thread removed context later unavailable to the public.
Whether the Sweden/fear narrative matches the actual travel timeline.
Whether political/media benefit followed the controversy and whether any evidence ties that benefit to motive.
research_priority: Recover original Facebook thread/export/screenshots with reply hierarchy.
Obtain original police complaint metadata and parliamentary-security referral record.
Obtain full August 12 judgment and charge exhibits.
Recover original TV2 segment where Mercado discussed the report and/or fear/Sweden.
Build a dated Sweden travel timeline from primary artifacts.
Compare every Mercado public statement to the exact defendant/comment it referred to.
Trace each newspaper sentence back to its first source rather than counting republications as independent evidence.
